column1: # contrib/ct-move-all.sh - one CT per row, whitespace separated. No defaults.
#   old_node  old_ctid  new_ctid  new_node  storage(on new_node)  [zfs=k=v,k=v]  [free text]
# zfs= is used only on a row's first round (recordsize affects new writes only).
# A storage that is one of the storage node's own pools (SRC_STORAGES in
# conf/ctmig.conf) is skipped here - put that row in inventory-migrate.tsv.
